text:
maria: Quick announce: we flipped the HotStart Warmup policy for short-prefix workloads in prod (us-west1, us-east1, eu-west1). Early aggregated results: p50 latency down ~18%, p99 down ~9%, per-token GPU cost roughly -7% on sampled traffic.

ben_s: amazing work, congrats! can you drop the canary link/queries?

maria: canary dashboard: https://dashboard.redwood-internal/boards/hotstart-warmup (infra access required). Canary id: hw-canary-2026-03-23. Example checks we ran: 
```
// example metric checks
avg_over_time(inference_latency_p50{policy="hotstart"}[1h]) - baseline_p50
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(token_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le))
```
Rolled 50% traffic per region for ~2h, then full flip.

suyash: any surprises on GPU mem or IO during warmup? warms can spike footprints.

maria: transient +6% GPU memory during warmup bursts on smallest model classes; still within safety (no OOM). Tuned prefetch_window=300ms and limited warmup concurrency to 8 jobs/node.

ajenkins: what's the fail-open/rollback criteria?

maria: auto-failover to cold path if any of these hold >5m in a region:
- p99 increases >12% vs baseline
- GPU memory >90% sustained 1m
- error rate delta >0.5%
We also left a one-click revert in Console (devops only).

irene: Dedicated customers? did we affect reserved pools?

maria: Dedicated is OPT_OUT by default. Dedicated admins can opt-in via Dedicated config: warmup_policy=OPT_IN|OPT_OUT. Enterprise customers can request a rollout via support.

deploy-bot: canary/hw-canary-2026-03-23 finished: 50->100% flip complete @3500000068 :white_check_mark:

ben_s: can we add a short note to runtime release notes with recommended settings for chat/short-llm workloads?

maria: adding release-note snippet now. TL;DR recommended values: prefetch_window=300ms, max_warmup_concurrency=8, short_prefix_threshold=64 tokens.

maria: Monitoring will watch tail behaviour for 72h. Ping me if you spot odd regressions. :party:
